title: Event props
description: Props the overlay layer itself reads on every event, accepted next to each component's own props.

full.description: Draw the brand backdrop under the component (a cutaway). Captions switch to their light-background colours unless `dark`.

dark.description: Backdrop in the brand's ink colour instead of its background colour.

behind.description: Draw the event under the speaker (person matte); short-form only.

layer.description: A field of the event, beside `props`. front (default): over the footage; behind: under the speaker's cut-out (same as `props.behind`); panel: under the footage, only while a `corner` camera move is on. Short-form only.

object.description: A field of the event, beside `props`. Events of one component sharing an id are the same story object coming back: their identifying props must match (DocCard: kicker, title, italic).

frame.description: Shrink and move the component (origin: top centre) to float a full-layout graphic over the footage.
